2026-10-23IRCC, IRBImmigration and Refugee Protection ActRules Amending the Refugee Protection Division Rules Rules Amending the Refugee Protection Division Rules in order to align the rules with legislative changes to the asylum system by amending the rules regarding (i) the submission of basis of claim information to support the new single online application process; (ii) new abandonment of claims before referral; (iii) the time limit for the disclosure of information and documents; and (iv) the method of communication with the Refugee Protection Division.Registration: SOR/2026-0219 Publication Date: 2026-11-04
subject: Rules Amending the Refugee Protection Division Rules
precis: Rules Amending the Refugee Protection Division Rules in order to align the rules with legislative changes to the asylum system by amending the rules regarding (i) the submission of basis of claim information to support the new single online application process; (ii) new abandonment of claims before referral; (iii) the time limit for the disclosure of information and documents; and (iv) the method of communication with the Refugee Protection Division.
